## The directive extension is not attached

These examples run with NO extension attached, and attachment is the only gate
there is (Q14): the parser option this file was named after does not exist any
more. The extension's syntax is ordinary Markdown here.

The title said "attach the extension without enabling its parser option", which
this file could never have shown -- the ctest entry passes no `--option`, the
examples carry no tags, and the runner starts from nothing attached. An oracle
that cannot tell "attached, option off" from "not attached" is the gap D1 lived
in for eleven releases.

```````````````````````````````` example
Use :cite[smith04] here.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:24 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:24 children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:24 literal="Use :cite[smith04] here." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
::youtube[Video]{vid=01ab2cd3efg}
.
Document scope=1:1..1:33 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:33 children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:33 literal="::youtube[Video]{vid=01ab2cd3efg}" children=0
````````````````````````````````
